name: PT Green Power Group Tbk
summary: Established in 1989 and based in Bekasi, Indonesia, PT Ladang Baja Murni Tbk specializes in the distribution of steel products and related derivatives throughout the country. The company's trading portfolio includes a diverse range of items such as rule die steel, general steel, copper, het lock, cutting rule products, and various spare parts. In addition to its trading activities, PT Ladang Baja Murni Tbk also manufactures finish plates, mold bases, and custom mold products. It operates as a subsidiary of PT Adyatama Global Investama.
